decisions.reason: Relocating the branded placard does not change the established beige and green color scheme.
The placard orientation changes a specific branding element but leaves the DJ-turntable-inspired visual identity unchanged.
The placard must face the customer, while the message preserves the spout's existing barista-side orientation; the separate spout decision from this message is already represented.
Placard placement does not alter bowl capacity, size, or form.
The branding-placement decision does not change the V1 sourcing policy; the message's separate custom-spout exception is already represented.
The customer-facing placard placement has no effect on the splash-control behavior.
The placard location is independently represented by the branding Requirement and does not change the CAD deliverable or its existing overall design direction.
Placard orientation does not affect bowl removal or swapping behavior.
The source decision changes a passive placard's placement and does not entail any wiring-plan change.
The placard-placement decision does not necessarily change motor or component selection or the BOM deliverable.
Changing which side the placard faces does not affect mixing quality or foam consistency.
Placard placement does not change fluid-path cleaning or sanitation requirements.
